subject: We have an MSA with Fraunhofer | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

We have an MSA in place with Fraunhofer as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your specific team within Fraunhofer as well.

For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like Fraunhofer, Baker Hughes and Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. They mostly use Encord to improve their data curation / annotation and model evaluation processes to iterate on their AI models faster and/or reduce development costs. 

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other Fraunhofer teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.

subject: [YEAR] AI roadmap
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Congratulations on your recent promotion to Director of AI Integration - I've been following Korro for some time & was curious to understand how you're thinking about AI model re-training to drive product improvements this year?

Given the behavioural complexities I imagine you're tracking across occupational therapy and healthcare settings, thought it could be relevant to introduce how Encord can help you capture this complexity in the training data (& improve vs. basic annotation tooling). 

Many of the CTOs / Heads of AI we work with were frustrated by the architectures of their existing annotation tooling (often CVAT or V7) limiting their ability to capture rich information from images / videos, as these labelling structures only support one level of depth.

We built Encord to support dynamic and nested labelling architecture of infinite depth, so you build richer, and more insightful models, faster. 

Open to learning more?

text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed that you have been growing very quickly in the last year, including adding [SENDER] to lead the perception team & hiring for a Senior ML Engineer, so it seems like fine-tuning your ML models could be top of mind for this year?

We work with leading robotics CTOs (including Pickle Robot, Carbon Robotics & Dexory) who were on a similar growth trajectory to Gravis, and were frustrated by slow model re-training hurting their ability to launch new ML products.

We built Encord to help AI teams remove data bottlenecks (focusing on data curation, annotation & active learning), so you can realise new revenue opportunities, faster.

Open to learning more?
